'''Kombat''' is a one-day FFA tournament played '''Saturday, December 10''', 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}} with a mix of traditional maps and new ones.
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match.

Discord: http://discord.gg/2qkVVan724

== Format ==
* Group stage
** 4 groups - ''all groups play simultaneously''
** 8 players per group
** Top 3 players proceed to grandfinal
** 4 Maps: '''AEROWALK PANZER ZTNDM3 HALO'''
* Final
** 12-16 players
** 4 Maps: '''BLOODWALK ROCKA CTL8 SCHLOSS''' 
* Saturday December 10, 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}}

== Rules ==
* Match rules:
** Timelimit: 11 minutes
** Powerups ON
** Dropquad enabled
** No fraglimit (fraglimit 0)
* Point system per map:
** 1st place, 5 points
** 2nd place, 4 points
** 3rd place, 3 points
** 4th place, 2 point
** 5th place, 1 point
* Reporting
** The winning player of each map is obligated to report with screenshot in main QW [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>
* In group stage, all groups are played simultaneously
* European tournament (played on EU servers (nl.aye.wtf, de.aye.wtf or qw.quakeworld.fi etc))
* Minimum 25 ms (ping up if lower)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
